active.description: false blocks new postings (FR-COA-04); a system account stays active.

control.description: Changes only with an approval, which arrives with the approval engine: refused until then.

currency.description: A bank account's currency; "" clears it.

default_gst_code.description: The GST code a line on it starts with; "" clears it.

function.description: COGS, R&D, S&M, G&A or Other; "" clears it.

group.description: Whether it is a heading; an account with postings stays a leaf.

guidance.description: Shown when someone picks the account; "" clears it.

money_account.description: A bank, cash, card or wallet account.

parent_id.description: The group account it sits under; "" moves it to the top.

payroll_cost.description: Changes only with an approval, like the control flag: refused until then.

revalue.description: Revalue its foreign-currency balances at month end: only an asset or a liability settled in money (FR-GL-04; COA-10). Months already revalued keep what they posted.

useful_life_months.description: The default useful life in whole months the fixed asset register offers, on an asset account of the register only (FR-COA-02; COA-11); 0 clears it. Registered assets keep their own lives.
